Though, as I said, the Executive and Federative Power of every Community  be really distinct in themselves, yet they are hardly to be separated and placed at the same time in the hands of distinct Persons. units.source: 150. In all Cases, whilst the Government subsists, the Legislative is the supream Power. For what can give Laws to another must needs be superiour to him; and since the Legislative is no otherwise Legislative of the Society, but by the right it has to make Laws for all the parts, and every Member of the Society prescribing Rules to their actions, and giving power of Execution where they are transgressed, the Legislative must needs be the Supream, and all other Powers in any Members or parts of the Society, derived from and subordinate to it.
